verdict.rationale: Yapily documents registrable webhooks that send real-time HTTP notifications of platform changes to a customer HTTPS endpoint, with subscriptions to multiple event categories. However, the only concrete event types evidenced are payment status updates, not the data changes this story asks about. missing for 10: evidence of webhook signing/signature verification, documented events for new transactions, balance updates and connection/consent state changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, data changes arrive as signed webhooks — new transactions, balance updates, connection state changes — so my system stays current without polling

citations.quote: Webhooks allows you to receive real-time HTTP notifications of changes happening in the Yapily Platform.
Create an endpoint on a secure server that can process HTTPS requests.
the ability to subscribe to multiple event categories within a single webhook.
